web_fixture.title: Troubleshooting - Cinder Deploy
web_fixture.content:
# Troubleshooting

`ERR_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT`: the new release did not pass its health check within 90 seconds, so traffic stays on the previous release. Raise `healthcheck.timeout` or fix the /healthz endpoint.

`ERR_IMAGE_PULL`: the registry rejected credentials.

turns.prompt: Cinder Deploy rolled back and says ERR_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT. Did my new version go live?
So what setting do I raise?
